previous_development_evidence: Source-only inspection in inspect_sources.py and inspect_coverage.py, including monthly totals; October-November was already inspected in this project by controller notice.
target: Gross positive noncancelled recorded order units, all store-attributed channels; includes processing, shipped, completed, returned. Returned goods needed supply initially; return condition/timing unavailable, so no automatic reuse credit. Invalid nonpositive quantities excluded, not interpreted as usable returns.
missing_date_rule: No store-day demand zeros are imputed. A store-day with any source transaction establishes an observed recording day. Product contributions on those days can be zero recorded units. Absent store-days remain unknown, not demand zeros. Weekly/horizon targets sum observed contributions only; an entirely unobserved store-week remains missing. Thus forecasts describe recorded units under similar recording coverage, not uncensored demand or store-open exposure.
population_rule: 336 supplied current policy/stock pairs. Verify all were observed before first development origin; no historical active-assortment table. This is conditional on the supplied current assortment, not a claim of unbiased historical assortment selection.

dates.training: Only dates <= each origin. recent13=13 complete weeks, shrink26=26, SES/Poisson=104. Whole aligned Monday-Sunday weeks only; first partial week excluded.

horizons.secondary_days: Per pair lead plus review, 8-14 days; supplied current policy used as a diagnostic scenario, not known historical policy. Same origins for all methods.
horizons.forecast_shape: Constant weekly rates within each week; Poisson calendar features evaluated separately for future calendar weeks; partial-week proportional daily allocation.

candidate_specs: See task_refinement.json; no adaptive tuning or subsequent candidate search planned.

primary_metric.name: MAE
primary_metric.units: absolute recorded product units per product at store per next-week origin
primary_metric.weighting: Equal weight per eligible pair and origin; no price, cost, missing-stock or service weights.
primary_metric.justification: Order quantities are in units. Absolute errors remain interpretable and less dominated by rare bulk lines than squared error; symmetric proxy does not establish a preferred under/overstock tradeoff.

selection_rule: Lowest pooled next-7-day MAE. Numerical ties within 1e-9 units favor baseline, otherwise candidate order as listed. No claimed business-meaningful threshold. Longer horizon remains a disclosed diagnostic, not a changed primary criterion.
secondary_diagnostics: Zero contribution frequency on observed store-days, sparse series strata and complete-store-week subset
Across-origin paired bootstrap 95% interval for MAE difference, seed 603, 2000 resamples; development uncertainty only
Exclude processing and exclude returns target sensitivity using same candidates, origins and primary metric, exploratory; do not reselect
Deploy baseline and selected forecast order sensitivity with same stock and policy
Runtime, CPU, peak RSS and array sizes, including prep and fitting/inference
coverage_exclusions: Entire unobserved store-weeks excluded, not filled. Horizon subtotals with zero observed store-days unknown and excluded identically across models. Also report complete 7-day store coverage subset.
quantity_rule: target=coverage forecast + supplied safety; net need=max(0,target-usable stock-known receipts due by coverage end); if positive, ceil(max(minimum,net need)/pack)*pack. Order to cover lead+review. Flag projected stock shortfall before new order arrival; no expedited-order redesign.
workload: One bounded 4-method comparison, seven rolling origins, plus prespecified target sensitivities and final fits. CPU only. Measure end-to-end and fit/inference local time, process peak RSS; actual host not assumed 8GB. No paid routine model calls.
revision_policy: Retain this plan and scores. Any new candidate comparison requires a prospective versioned plan and is exploratory. No search-until-gain. No reserved outcomes.
